services.name: Rock Steady Boxing
services.desc: Rocksteady Boxing is class specifically designed to help people battling Parkinson’s disease. The Sweet Science Boxing and Fitness’s Rocksteady is fun but challenging class! The first half of class focuses on developing strength, stamina, coordination, balance, and functional fitness while the second half of class uses boxing to reverse the effects of Parkinson’s disease. Boxing is extremely effective for Parkinson’s patients because throwing proper punches requires the use of the whole body, working people in a way that cannot be replicated though any other method.
